title: Size bound for bounded-fanin circuits
statement: For every Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ variables whose maximum fanin is at most $2$, the size of $C$ plus $1$ is at most $2$ raised to the power of its depth plus $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
The maximum fanin of $C$ is at most $2$
